methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
The above criterion provides the rational basis for the selection of the best auto-id 
system with logistics system energy consumption taken into account.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The proposed criterion evaluates and selects auto-id systems while merely taking energy consumption into account; it does not identify or characterise an EnPI or EnB model.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
A case illustrating the use 
of the new method of evaluating auto-id systems is presented.

stage1.notes: ISO 50001 is discussed, but the equations model information utility and system selection rather than an EnPI/EnB baseline.
